# StreamDek Mobile — 17 August 2026

## New

**Premium services now alert the user on the service status when starting a stream**
Real-Debrid, AllDebrid, Premiumize, TorBox, Debrid-Link and Deepbrid have their responses
surfaced on the mobile app. So the user know exactly what's happening

**Introduced clear trailer caches**
Trailers can stop playing when the stored playback state and/or app_webview goes stale. 
StreamDek now allows the user to manually clear or set auto times when the trailer caches 
should be cleared to allow the app keep playing trailers

**Robust StreamDek Catalogs**
We have now introduced robust default catalogs curated by streamdek. These catalogs allows  
for the ultimate streaming experience. Thirty default home rows, ordered as a browsing sequence 
rather than a taxonomy: what's hot, then what's new and in cinemas, where to watch it, 
what everyone is watching, what is worth watching, and progressively more specific ways in. 
Every row is defined once in the registry and pages as deep as TMDB will go.

**Robust Subtitles Settings and Features**
We have now introduced robust subtitles settings that allow the user to set up to 2 preferred languages and have the app load only those languages into the player. 

**Dominant color mode**
Introduced dominant background color mode in settings for the title and episode streams pages

## Fixed

**Premium-service sign-in and source failures explain what happened**
Failed or cancelled sign-ins now remain visible on the Premium Services page. Sources that
cannot be resolved because a title has no IMDb identifier say so directly, and packed
Usenet posts are refused before the player is handed an archive fragment it cannot play.
